title: ERepo combination benchmark: ACMG/AMP 2015 rules versus the Bayesian point system (v1.0.0)
description: Code to reproduce the re-classification of 13,012 ClinGen Evidence Repository interpretations from their applied evidence codes with three published combiners (ACMG/AMP 2015 rules, rules with the ClinGen SVI adjustment, and the naturally scaled Bayesian point system).

creators.name: Jiménez Nieto, Nuria
creators.affiliation: Innovare Genetics (AI Innovare Group S.L.), Madrid, Spain
